title: change-42-yhmm/quota-float
claim: change-42-yhmm/quota-float — A lightweight Windows/macOS desktop widget that keeps your Codex quota visible from your local Codex Desktop session.
why_good: Quota Float is a lightweight desktop widget for Windows and macOS that displays your Codex quota, including your 5-hour and weekly limits, in a compact, always-visible format. It provides real-time updates on your quota status and reset times.
value: Codex users who need precise quota monitoring will pay for Quota Float to avoid unexpected usage limits that could disrupt their workflows.
risk: The primary risk is competition from existing Codex management tools that may offer broader features, potentially overshadowing Quota Float's focused utility.
